region: Dundee · Seneca Lake, Finger Lakes, New York
about: Glenora Wine Cellars sits on the west shore of Seneca Lake near Dundee, and it was the first winery on the lake, founded in 1977 by local growers Gene Pierce, Eastman Beers and Edward Dalrymple with businessman Howard Kimball. Its first vintage of about 5,000 cases won medals at the New York State Fair, and the winery grew to include a café, a restaurant and an inn overlooking the water. Since 2025 it has been owned by Lilly Broadcasting, led by brothers Brian and Kevin Lilly.

This non-vintage, port-style dessert wine is one of the winery’s long-standing tasting-room favorites. It is fortified to 18% alcohol and finished sweet, with about 6% residual sugar, balanced by moderate acidity. Its raspberry and vanilla notes make it a natural partner for dark chocolate, berry desserts or a cheese course at the end of a meal.
